subject: Adopt Intercommunications Enhancements Primary-agent hardening contract locally
body: Primary retains architectural/release responsibility and integration authority; every spawned agent inherits project identity; routing and mutation fail closed on missing/conflicting project identity; cross-project access is deny-by-default; artifacts/tasks/locks are project-scoped; meaningful state changes are auditable; and changes affecting communication, bootstrap, schemas, roles or package behavior require impact analysis and synchronized PRIMARY/MANAGER/RESEARCH package updates before a coordinated release is declared complete.
